strings.draw: No moves remain. Each player earns 150 points.
strings.ended: The host ended this match. Points already earned stay.
strings.exact: Exact finish · Extra steps bounce back
strings.trailNote: Eight cheeky snakes. Eight handy ladders.
strings.waitReason: Wait for your turn to roll.
help: Roll a die and count along the winding trail from 1 to 100.
Landing on a ladder foot climbs to its top. Landing on a snake head slides to its tail.
With Exact finish off, any roll reaching 100 finishes. With it on, extra steps bounce backwards from 100.
The timer auto-rolls after 15 seconds at Normal pace. First home gets 300, then 200, 100 and 0.
